profile_text.body:
Adobe is a public company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, CA. It operates across creative software, document management, and digital media, and its SEC filings (CIK 0000796343, ticker ADBE) record revenue of approximately $23,769,000,000 for the period ending November 28, 2025. The company's website, as harvested from the Adobe Express domain, describes Adobe Express as an all-in-one design, photo, and video tool intended to make content creation easy, with the ability to produce social content, videos, and logos quickly.

Adobe tracks several AI products across its portfolio. Adobe Express AI is described as a lightweight design tool with integration of Adobe Firefly, positioned for quick content creation and marketed as commercially safe. Adobe Firefly is a standalone image generation product that Adobe describes as trained in a commercially safe manner. Premiere Pro AI extends the professional video editing suite with features such as generative extend and color match, also carrying the commercially safe training claim. Adobe Podcast AI offers audio enhancement capabilities including speech enhancement and microphone check, again with a commercially safe training claim. The site additionally notes an AI Assistant 2 within Adobe Express that allows users to prompt, create, and edit content while preserving chosen elements across layers.
